Solving for x

Algebra is a tool we use all term.

Isolate the unknown on one side.

Apply the same operation to both sides.

Check the units as you go.

Write every step down.

Keep significant figures in mind.

Rearrange PV = nRT for n.

Substitute the known values.

Divide to find the answer.

Round at the end only.
